To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed MILP model is capable of providing a systematic tool that can be used by policy makers in order to analyse various scenarios concerning the long term planning of an energy system.

our model is capable to provide a comprehensive long term planning of the power system of the Greek islands and to identify the optimal power generation technologies and their corresponding locations as well as the required transmission and transportation infrastructure.

the model can provide a useful tool for policy makers to analyse different scenarios and technology options in order to achieve the optimal energy mix for each country, which is a very important issue for the energy security and sustainability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimal spatial multi period long-term energy planning problem.
the development of a MILP model to support the energy planning decision making process.

the development of a spatial multi-period long term energy planning optimization model that is capable of providing policy makers with a computer aided tool to evaluate different scenarios and technology options.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed model is capable to capture the spatial characteristics of the power generation problem, the interaction among the networks, the electricity transmission and the transportation of primary fuels, the CO2 emission constraints as well as to evaluate various scenarios and technology choices.
the proposed model is capable of capturing all the key aspects of the energy planning problem, while providing a useful and effective tool for decision makers.
the proposed model can serve as a useful tool for policy makers in order to analyse and assess various energy planning scenarios and technology options.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an innovative MILP model for the optimal planning of a power generation system.
the model is capable of providing a useful insight into the Greek energy planning problems and can be used as an important decision support tool for the Greek energy policy makers.
the proposed approach is capable of providing an effective decision support system for the long term energy planning problem of a (national or regional) electricity system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed MILP model can help policy makers in making better decisions for the long term energy planning.
the proposed model can provide policy makers and decision makers with a systematic tool to analyse different scenarios and technology options in order to achieve an optimal long term energy system.
the proposed approach can be applied in other countries with similar energy planning problems.
